map.租赁费率计算工具，根据设备原值、租期、残值率、年利率和付款方式，基于等额本息法计: The lease-rate calculator, from equipment original value, lease term, residual-value rate, annual interest rate and payment method, computes rent per period, total rent, total interest and return on investment by the equal-principal-and-interest method.
map.总租金/总利息/回报率: Total rent / total interest / return rate
map.设备融资租赁租金（本页代码口径，等额本息模型）：残值=原值×残值率%、需回收本金: Equipment finance lease rent (code basis of this page, equal-payment amortization model): residual value = original value × residual rate %, principal to recover = original value − residual value, total management fee = original value × management fee rate % × lease term in years; per-period rate r = annual rate % ÷ 100 ÷ periods per year (monthly 12, quarterly 4, annual 1), total periods N = lease term in months × periods per year ÷ 12, rounded; PMT = principal × r × (1+r)^N ÷ [(1+r)^N−1] (when r=0, use (principal + management fee) ÷ N; for payment at the beginning of each period, divide again by (1+r)); rent per period = PMT + management fee ÷ N, total rent = rent per period × N, total interest = total rent − principal − total management fee, total recovery = total rent + residual value, return on investment = (total recovery − original value) ÷ original value × 100%. Validation: range-check all five inputs (original value >0, lease term >0, residual rate/annual rate/management fee rate ∈[0,100]); any violation reports an error and stops. Criterion: no fixed grading; only compares the annualized return with the set rate to indicate a low rate or a reasonable plan.
